messages:
Carina: quick flag 1: p99 on the latency table spiked for a few routes after the routing tag rollout. p50/p95 look normal. anyone else seeing this?
Toni: saw it in morning checks. which routes?
Carina: api.user.profile.v1 and admin.session.v1; p99 jumped ~700ms for some rows.
Jasper: that pattern usually means a tiny cohort with large outliers. Did the rollout emit new tag variants?
Kim: yes2: telemetry shows `route` and `route.variant` coexisting during the transition window. we ended up with two origins for the same logical endpoint.
Carina: console merged per-origin percentiles and displayed the highest p99. small-sample extreme drove the row up.
Toni: short term: UI should show sample_count + origin breakdown and a low-sample tooltip. gray p99 when total samples < 100.
Jasper: medium term: merge tdigest blobs to compute correct combined percentiles instead of picking per-origin scalars. I did a quick merge: combined p99 -> 165ms vs naive 2.1s. CPU delta small for test.
Kim: careful: billing uses `route` tag. any canonicalization must preserve billing labels. propose adding `canonical_route` for metrics and keeping `route` for quota.
Carina: plan: Toni -> small UI PR for counts & tooltip; Jasper -> spike tdigest merge and perf; Kim -> check billing compatibility.
deploy-bot: deploy: routing-rollout v1.9.8 finished us-west-2 at 2026-03-21T12:21:10Z :white_check_mark:
Carina: filing ENGPLAT-7601 for tracking. will post updates here. thanks all :thumbsup:
